guards.what: UNIT GAP: NondescriptGuilty's two card-reward screens are not modelled at all. Trial.cs:177-187 adds Doubt and then builds TWO `CardReward(CardCreationOptions.ForNonCombatWithDefaultOdds([Owner.Character.CardPool]), 3, Owner)` entries and hands them to RewardsCmd.OfferCustom; events/trial.py:90-93 adds Doubt and finishes, with a comment ('Two card-reward offers (RewardsCmd.OfferCustom) are not modelled') naming the omission
guards.issue: This is a MISSING EFFECT, wider than EV-4 (which is a modelled grant that should have been an offer) and wider than EV-6 (which is the wrong factory): here the screens, the cards and the draws are all absent. The sim has both halves of the capability -- rewards.create_reward_cards (rewards.py:235-275) is the faithful CreateForReward port for exactly the ForNonCombatWithDefaultOdds(characterPool) shape and events/brain_leech.py:44-47 already calls it, while Event.pending_reward_extras / resume_after_combat (events/base.py:94-99, 116-122) is the sim's take-or-skip channel -- so nothing was missing to build it with. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/event_probes_b.py trialoffer`): driving the NONDESCRIPT page and choosing GUILTY raises ZERO card-selection screens and offers 0 cards where the game offers 2 screens x 3 = 6, and the deck delta is always exactly 1 (Doubt) where the game's is 1 to 3. LIVE: NONDESCRIPT is one of three equally weighted trials on an ungated event, and taking two card rewards is a large, permanent deck change. It also drops every draw CreateForReward would take off the Rewards stream, so the whole EV-6 observable set (rarity odds, the act-scaled upgrade draw, the stream) is absent rather than merely wrong.

guards.what: EV-10: events/trial.py:97's NONDESCRIPT_INNOCENT transform screen (Trial.cs:192) builds its candidate list from RunState.transformable_cards (run.py:364-366), which returns removable_cards() -- 'not Eternal'. CardSelectCmd.FromDeckForTransformation filters `c.Type != CardType.Quest && c.IsTransformable` (CardSelectCmd.cs:485-489); the sim drops the QUEST clause
guards.issue: MECHANISM EV-10, one verdict at every transformable_cards() site (rule 3). Half of the sim's comment is right: for a card sitting in the Deck pile, CardModel.IsTransformable really does reduce to IsRemovable (CardModel.cs:737-750 -- the extra clause only fires for an Eternal card that is NOT in the deck), and CardSelectCmd.FromDeckForRemoval (CardSelectCmd.cs:621-625) genuinely has no Quest clause, so removable_cards() itself is correct. The defect is that the TRANSFORM screen adds one and the sim's helper reuses the removal predicate. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/event_probes_b.py quest`): three Quest cards are ported -- byrdonis_egg, lantern_key, spoils_map -- and a deck of [strike, spoils_map, lantern_key] offers all three on the sim's transform screen where the game offers only strike; transforming spoils_map turns it into a Colorless card (the probe rolled `calamity`) and the Quest card is gone from the deck for good. LIVE, both sides proven reachable with ported content (rule 6): the grant paths are events/the_legends_were_true.py:41 (Spoils Map, act 1 NAB_THE_MAP), events/the_lantern_key.py:44 (Lantern Key, the fight's SpecialCardReward) and events/byrdonis_nest.py:45 (Byrdoni's Egg), and every transform site is an ordinary event branch. RADIUS BEYOND THIS RECORD (not re-verdicted, rule 3): events/aroma_of_chaos.py:25, events/endless_conveyor.py:96, events/morphic_grove.py:41, events/symbiote.py:50, events/whispering_hollow.py:62, events/wood_carvings.py:38, plus relics/astrolabe.py:21 and relics/new_leaf.py:16 (the relic stream's). CORRECTED IN THE REVIEW FIX PASS -- the earlier text here claimed "events/morphic_grove.py:30 is the sharpest case: its IsAllowed gates on `len(run.transformable_cards()) >= 2`, so a Quest card can make the sim OFFER an event node the game would not." That is FALSE and is now disproven by execution rather than merely withdrawn. The game's gate is `p.Deck.Cards.Count(c => c.IsTransformable) >= 2` (MorphicGrove.cs:26), and IsTransformable (CardModel.cs:739-750) reduces to `!Eternal` for a card in the Deck pile -- it has NO Quest clause. The Quest clause lives only on the transform SCREEN (CardSelectCmd.cs:487, `c.Type != CardType.Quest && c.IsTransformable`), which is this mechanism. EXECUTED (ad-hoc, repo root): deck [strike, spoils_map], gold 100 -- sim `MorphicGroveEvent.is_allowed` True, game `Count(c => c.IsTransformable) >= 2` True (count 2). Both engines OFFER the event; the gates agree. The real divergence is one step later and is still LIVE, so EV-10's verdict is unaffected: the sim's screen offers ['strike','spoils_map'] where the game's offers ['strike'], and because MorphicGrove passes `new CardSelectorPrefs(prompt, 2)` -- MinSelect == MaxSelect == 2, so RequireManualConfirmation is false (CardSelectorPrefs.cs:68-78) -- the game's one-card list is auto-taken whole (CardSelectCmd.cs:493-495) and it transforms ONE card, while the sim transforms TWO and destroys the Quest card. Recorded on event/morphic_grove as well.

guards.what: DoubleDown (Trial.cs:128-132) opens NAbandonRunConfirmPopup, whose Yes button calls RunManager.Instance.Abandon() (NAbandonRunConfirmPopup.cs:69-74); events/trial.py:63-65 calls run.kill() -- hp = 0 -- immediately and unconditionally
guards.rationale: Same observable outcome, different shape: the run is over either way, and for a headless sim 'abandoned' and 'dead' are the same terminal state. CRITICALLY, this is NOT an EV-1 site and must not be recorded as one (rule 3): EV-1's second verb is about run.kill standing in for `CreatureCmd.Kill(creature, force: false)`, whose Hook.ShouldDie / AfterPreventingDeath pass a belt Fairy in a Bottle answers. Abandon() is not CreatureCmd.Kill at all -- it is the meta run-teardown path the main menu and pause menu also use (NMainMenu / NPauseMenu / NAbandonRunButton are the other three callers), and CreatureCmd.cs:436 names 'abandoning a run' as precisely the `force: true` case that BYPASSES the pass. So no death-prevention listener would fire in the game either, and the sim loses nothing by not running one. Recorded here so a future reader does not add this to EV-1's site list by pattern-matching on run.kill.
